mechanism.claim: A polarity transition between consecutive same-direction SPY/TLT consensus sessions changes the broad risk-parity liquidity regime rather than merely extending a level. During elevated BTC variation, follow the new common direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: new common strict sign of SPY and TLT after an opposite common sign at the immediately prior source-valid session
mechanism.why_distinct: HVRPC trades every high-variation SPY/TLT consensus level and failed train. HVRPCTR trades only common-direction polarity transitions between consecutive frozen consensus sessions, forming a new event topology. It uses no HVRPC event set/control, credit spread, crypto direction, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular external risk-parity consensus polarity transitions are sparser than the terminal level clock

features.consensus: current SPY and TLT returns are strict nonzero with one common sign
features.previous: immediately prior source-valid shared cash session is also consensus
features.transition: current and previous common consensus signs are strict opposites

clock.reservation: chronological half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no assets, consensus, previous-session law, transition, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
